benchmark.comparability_caveat: This executes the complete Harness paper-v3 eight-cell plan with one shared evolving scaffold. It uses the released RLinf policy without the unreleased Harness memory agent.

related_transfer_presets.claim_scope: Within-environment related-task transfer only; arbitrary disjoint task selections do not support this claim.
related_transfer_presets.split_kind: same scene, new spatial relation + same scene, new object + new scene, same skills
related_transfer_presets.split_rationale: This route runs several task suites at once, so the split is a union. Same bowl, same plate, same room. Only the words saying where the bowl starts change, so what is tested is whether the change still works when the object sits somewhere new. Same verb, same basket, same room. Only the object being picked up changes, so what is tested is whether the change still works on a thing it has never picked up. Held-out uses kitchen and living-room layouts that never appear in evolve, with different furniture and a different object set. The skills are the same multi-step pick, place and open jobs. This is a harder jump than the other LIBERO splits and should be read as scene transfer, not task transfer.

starting_agent.architecture: Frozen low-level policy exposed as one tool beside planner and perception tools
